name: Twenty-Twentiers — The Collapse Nostalgia Scene
description: Twenty-Twentiers are obsessed with the 2020-2040 period — specifically the cultural output, fashion, and media of the pre-Consolidation era, which they romanticize as 'the last time individuals made things that mattered.' They source or replica-print vintage streetwear, collect physical media (phones, tablets, streaming service merchandise), and speak in reconstructed slang pieced together from archived social media. The community is divided between Archivists, who care about historical accuracy, and Vibers, who treat the era as aesthetic mood board without concern for authenticity. Their gathering space is the Twenty-Twenty Exchange in Tier 2's Wicker Sprawl — a flea market and cultural center where replica 2020s goods trade for real Φ.
cultural_impact: Twenty-Twentier aesthetics have leaked into mainstream Tier 3 fashion cycles, which the community resents as corporate co-optation — corponation retail brands now sell 'vintage Collapse-era' lines that Twenty-Twentiers call 'corpowash.'
locations: The Twenty-Twenty Exchange, Wicker Sprawl Tier 2
Dead Platform Archive, Underworld node V2K
story_hooks: A Twenty-Twentier Archivist has found genuine pre-Consolidation data caches that contain embarrassing corporate histories the corponations have been paying to suppress — and she doesn't realize what she has.

The Twenty-Twenty Exchange is being bought out by a nostalgia-brand corponation that wants to turn it into a theme-park version of itself — and the community must decide whether to fight, sell, or relocate underground.
A Vibe-faction Twenty-Twentier has been wearing replica clothing containing actual working 2030s surveillance firmware — someone planted it to track a meeting.
